cells.quote: Students reported significant improvement in self-efficacy from pre- to post-surveys in all modules.
cells.note: The abstract reports significant pre- to post-improvement but provides no printed effect size or test statistic.

cells.quote: Students appear to give and receive handovers more effectively in Module 5 (post-clerkship) despite the higher complexity.
cells.note: The abstract provides no printed effect size or test statistic and does not state whether the module comparison used random assignment or the same learners.
